'''Barada''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] who lived on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] around [[44 ABY]]. He had a son named [[Kelkad]], and worked as a [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] vendor in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Treema]].
